description: Charging honesty (issue eink-ha-os#11, emulator src/core/power.ts powerSource/batteryLabel, firmware core/power.h). charging = charger STAT pin; usb = a USB host is seen (HWCDC SOF). A full battery on USB drops STAT, so it reads 'on USB', never 'charging'. A full battery on a charger without data lines reads 'battery' (no VBUS pin confirmed on the X4 Pro). source = GET /status power.source; label = the About screen Battery row.

cases.name: full on a computer: STAT dropped
cases.label: 100% · on USB

cases.name: full on a wall charger: indistinguishable
